name: azd-emergency-access
title: Emergency access Conditional Access exclusion
description: Keeps a Microsoft Entra emergency access (break-glass) security group excluded from Conditional Access policies, using one of four selectable deployment modes: an Azure Automation runbook, a scheduled Azure Functions PowerShell app, a scheduled Consumption Logic App, or a Microsoft Sentinel near-real-time detection with an alert-triggered playbook that invokes an Entra-protected Function. Also includes an idempotent postprovision tenant bootstrap for the emergency access users, group, and restricted administrative unit, with optional Temporary Access Pass provisioning.
author: nathanmcnulty
